en: The postcard displays a black-and-white photograph of a modernist-style building with large windows and a geometric facade. In the foreground, there is a statue or sculpture of a woman in a small garden-like area. Another building and some trees can be seen in the background. The architecture and style suggest early 20th-century European design. At the bottom, there is old-fashioned cursive text.
